verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec and a CLI, but nothing in the evidence shows an endpoint that returns the GPU catalog with live pricing or availability. The only availability material is a static docs page saying CPU machines exist in all regions, and the marketing pages claim savings without any queryable prices. A general-purpose API is a building block, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend
